mapper.select: SELECT id AS route_id, province, city, summary, travel_group , budget_level , start_at , end_at , created_at FROM route_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT rr.id AS route_id, rr.province, rr.city, rr.summary, rr.travel_group , rr.budget_level , rr.start_at , rr.end_at , rr.created_at FROM route_record rr, route_favorite as rf WHERE rr.id = rf.route_id and rf.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rf.created_at DESC
